problem.title: Match Queue First and Last Accept Times
problem.prompt: You are analyzing a console online service's matchmaking system. The `match_acceptance_log` table records each player's response when offered a match slot, modeled on public gaming platform telemetry datasets (Steam / Xbox Live session logs). Each row captures `player_id`, `queue_session_id` (a unique queue attempt for that player), `offered_at` (timestamp when the slot was offered, stored as TEXT), `response_status` (acceptance decision, stored as an array of tags describing the response), `response_latency_ms` (time to respond, may be NULL if timed out), and `server_region` (region code, may have leading/trailing whitespace). Write a query that, for each player and queue session, returns the player ID (lowercase), the queue session ID, the server region (trimmed and title-case), the timestamp of the FIRST offer in that session, the timestamp of the LAST offer in that session, the month name of the last offer, the rounded average response latency (ignoring NULLs), and a flag indicating whether the session included any 'declined' responses. Order results by player_id, then queue_session_id.
problem.schema_ddl: CREATE TABLE match_acceptance_log (player_id TEXT NOT NULL, queue_session_id INTEGER NOT NULL, offered_at TEXT NOT NULL, response_status TEXT[] NOT NULL, response_latency_ms NUMERIC, server_region TEXT NOT NULL);

composite_moves: type-cast offered_at TEXT to TIMESTAMP for ordering
trim and initcap server_region for display

FIRST_VALUE and LAST_VALUE window functions over PARTITION BY player_id, queue_session_id ORDER BY offered_at::TIMESTAMP with explicit ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING frame for LAST_VALUE
extract month name from last_offer using TO_CHAR
compute AVG(response_latency_ms) ignoring NULLs using window function
check if 'declined' is ANY element in response_status array using = ANY(array)
GROUP BY to collapse window results to one row per partition

hints: You'll need to identify the first and last offer timestamp within each player's queue session. Consider how window functions can access values at partition boundaries.
The default frame for window functions only looks up to the current row. To get the true last value in a partition, you must explicitly specify a frame that extends to the partition's end.

Use FIRST_VALUE and LAST_VALUE with PARTITION BY player_id, queue_session_id ORDER BY offered_at::TIMESTAMP. For LAST_VALUE, add ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING. Clean player_id with LOWER, server_region with TRIM and INITCAP, extract the month with TO_CHAR, round the average latency, and check for 'declined' in the response_status array with = ANY(response_status).
problem.answer_key:
WITH windowed AS (
  SELECT
    LOWER(player_id) AS player_id,
    queue_session_id,
    INITCAP(TRIM(server_region)) AS server_region,
    offered_at::TIMESTAMP AS offered_ts,
    response_latency_ms,
    'declined' = ANY(response_status) AS is_decline,
    FIRST_VALUE(offered_at::TIMESTAMP) OVER (
      PARTITION BY player_id, queue_session_id
      ORDER BY offered_at::TIMESTAMP
    ) AS first_offer_time,
    LAST_VALUE(offered_at::TIMESTAMP) OVER (
      PARTITION BY player_id, queue_session_id
      ORDER BY offered_at::TIMESTAMP
      ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING
    ) AS last_offer_time
  FROM match_acceptance_log
)
SELECT
  player_id,
  queue_session_id,
  server_region,
  first_offer_time,
  last_offer_time,
  TO_CHAR(last_offer_time, 'Month') AS last_offer_month,
  ROUND(AVG(response_latency_ms)) AS avg_latency_ms,
  BOOL_OR(is_decline) AS had_decline
FROM windowed
GROUP BY player_id, queue_session_id, server_region, first_offer_time, last_offer_time
ORDER BY player_id, queue_session_id;

_meta.scenario: a console online service tracking multiplayer match acceptance

user_solution:
/*

match_acceptance_log
- records each player's response when offered a match slot

INPUTS
Table: match_acceptance_log
player_id	                    TEXT NOT NULL
queue_session_id	            INTEGER NOT NULL
offered_at	                    TEXT NOT NULL
response_status	                TEXT[] NOT NULL
response_latency_ms	            NUMERIC
server_region	                TEXT NOT NULL

OUTPUT
player_id	
queue_session_id	
server_region	
first_offer_time	the timestamp of the FIRST offer in that session
last_offer_time	    the timestamp of the LAST offer in that session
last_offer_month	the month name of the last offer
avg_latency_ms	    rounded average response latency (ignoring NULLs)
had_decline          session included any 'declined' responses

SELECT
    player_id,
    queue_session_id,
    server_region,
    first_offer_time,
    last_offer_time,
    last_offer_month,
    AVG(CASE WHEN response_latency_ms IS NOT NULL THEN response_latency_ms END)::int avg_latency_ms,
    had_decline
FROM base
WHERE rn = 1
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8
ORDER BY player_id, queue_session_id;

*/
WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        LOWER(TRIM(player_id)) AS player_id,
        queue_session_id,
        INITCAP(TRIM(server_region)) AS server_region,
        FIRST_VALUE(TRIM(offered_at)::timestamp) OVER (PARTITION BY LOWER(TRIM(player_id)), queue_session_id ORDER BY TRIM(offered_at)::timestamp ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS first_offer_time,
        LAST_VALUE(TRIM(offered_at)::timestamp) OVER (PARTITION BY LOWER(TRIM(player_id)), queue_session_id ORDER BY TRIM(offered_at)::timestamp ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS last_offer_time,
        TO_CHAR(LAST_VALUE(TRIM(offered_at)::timestamp) OVER (PARTITION BY LOWER(TRIM(player_id)), queue_session_id ORDER BY TRIM(offered_at)::timestamp ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING), 'Month') AS last_offer_month,
        (AVG(response_latency_ms) OVER (PARTITION BY LOWER(TRIM(player_id)), queue_session_id ORDER BY TRIM(offered_at)::timestamp ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING))::int AS avg_latency_ms,
        ('declined' = ANY(response_status)) AS had_decline,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY LOWER(TRIM(player_id)), queue_session_id ORDER BY ('declined' = ANY(response_status)) DESC, TRIM(offered_at)::timestamp ) AS rn
    FROM match_acceptance_log
)
SELECT
    player_id,
    queue_session_id,
    server_region,
    first_offer_time,
    last_offer_time,
    last_offer_month,
    avg_latency_ms,
    had_decline
FROM base
WHERE rn = 1;
